lede: Illinois carries the stronger underlying team rating — +3.0 against +1.7, a 1.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Michigan State -1.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Michigan State winning 52% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is receivers, where Illinois leads Michigan State by 97 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 84% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
